_note: pill_clouds transition art (Lib/PillClouds), in 1920x1080 pixels. Places are measured from the screen's centre along the travel axis (leaning tilt_deg to the right, up positive) and across it; reach is the farthest screen corner along that axis. Texture sizes and rows are in the textures' own pixels.

pills._note: four pills w x l, step px apart across the travel axis (neighbours overlap by w - step); the capsule in Pill.png is px_w x px_l, inside its clear border; they start start_gap px below the screen

clouds._note: CloudEdge.png is edge_w x edge_h and repeats across; its rows: tips the first puff, solid the first all body colour, base the clear border. The edge is one strip_w long quad, its ends off screen. The body (CloudBody.png, body_px square) is body_w wide and ends bury px under the edge's solid rows, never more than body_overdraw px past the screen. The bank starts and ends margin px past the screen
